films.ov: Inhabitants of a small village in Hungary deal with the effects of the fall of Communism. The town's source of revenue, a factory, has closed, and the locals, who include a doctor and three couples, await a cash payment offered in the wake of the shuttering. Irimias, a villager thought to be dead, returns and, unbeknownst to the locals, is a police informant. In a scheme, he persuades the villagers to form a commune with him.
A naive young man witnesses an escalation of violence in his small hometown following the arrival of a mysterious circus attraction.

A look at the monotonous daily struggle of a father and daughter in a windswept, desolate landscape. Over six days, their routine of eating boiled potatoes and tending a failing horse crumbles, symbolizing a slow descent into darkness, emptiness, and the end of existence.

Karrer plods his way through life in quiet desperation. His environment is drab and rainy and muddy. Eaten up with solitude, his hopelessness would be incurable but for the existence of the Titanik Bar and its beautiful, haunting singer. But the lady is married and Karrer is determined to keep her husband away...
A switchman at a seaside railway witnesses a murder but does not report it after he finds a suitcase full of money at the scene of the crime.
In this dense setting, the inhabitants of a large, claustrophobic apartment reveal their darkest secrets, fears, obsessions and hostilities.

fg: György Fehér's Films According to Béla Tarr
tarr.desc: A Hungarian director whose late films, made with the novelist László Krasznahorkai, follow people through mud, wind and rain in intricately choreographed long takes.
tarr.sig: Films a bleak, muddy Hungary in black and white, in takes that can last ten minutes.
facts: Sátántangó runs over seven hours.
Worked closely with novelist László Krasznahorkai, composer Mihály Víg and editor Ágnes Hranitzky.
Announced his retirement from features after The Turin Horse.
lists: 3 films in the TSPDT 1,000 Greatest Films; the highest is Sátántangó at #102.
3 films received votes in the 2022 Sight and Sound critics' poll; the highest is Sátántangó at #70.
On the House of Tabula film studies watchlist: Sátántangó.
On The House of Tabula's cinematic complexity iceberg: The Turin Horse (tier 5).

films.ov: New York layabout Willie forms an unexpected bond with his young Hungarian cousin Eva when she pays him a surprise visit. Later, Eva moves in with their aunt in Cleveland, and Willie takes his best friend Eddie to see her—a visit that culminates in a strange, eventful trip to Florida.
On the run after committing murder, an accountant encounters a strange Native American man who prepares him for his journey into the spiritual world.
A disc jockey, a pimp and an Italian tourist escape from jail in New Orleans.

films.t: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
films.ov: A Black hitman who models after the samurai of old finds himself targeted for death by the mob.
In the sleepy town of Centerville, the lives of a number of interconnected characters are disrupted by the undead.
A depressed musician reunites with his lover. However, their romance, already played over several centuries, is disrupted by the arrival of her uncontrollable younger sister.

fg: Red Hot + Blue: A Tribute to Cole Porter
Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
A Short Film by Jim Jarmusch, Starring Beatrice Domond
jarmusch.desc: Came out of the New York downtown music scene. His films follow outsiders and foreigners drifting through America, and find comedy in pauses and misunderstandings.
jarmusch.sig: The cool minimalist of American independent film, drawn to drifters, strangers and dead time.
facts: Often casts musicians, including Tom Waits, John Lurie and Iggy Pop.
Stranger Than Paradise is built from single-shot scenes separated by black.
Studied under Nicholas Ray at NYU.
awards: Coffee and Cigarettes: Somewhere in California
lists: 3 films in the TSPDT 1,000 Greatest Films; the highest is Stranger Than Paradise at #390.
1 film received votes in the 2022 Sight and Sound critics' poll; the highest is Stranger Than Paradise at #850.
On the House of Tabula film studies watchlist: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai.
2 films in Cahiers du cinéma's top 10 of the year, 1996 to 1999.
Named on 3 pages of The Oxford History of World Cinema.

films.ov: In a small village in a valley everyone who reaches the age of 70 must leave the village and go to a certain mountain top to die. If anyone should refuse they would disgrace their family. Old Orin is 69. This winter it is her turn to go to the mountain. But first she must make sure that her eldest son Tatsuhei finds a wife.

A businessman kills his adulterous wife and is sent to prison. After his release, he opens a barbershop and meets new people, talking  to almost no one except for an eel he befriended while in prison.
A thief, a murderer, and a charming lady-killer, Iwao Enokizu is on the run from the police.

Shigematsu Shizuma, who lives with his family in a village near Fukuyama, was in Hiroshima with his wife and niece just after the devastating atomic bombing, a tragedy that cruelly took the lives of thousands of people and forever marked the harsh existence of the survivors.

Eleven directors from eleven countries each contribute an eleven-minute short reflecting on the events of 11 September 2001: A village teacher in Iran tries to explain to her young students what's happened; city kids in Burkina Faso think they've spotted Osama bin Laden; a deaf Frenchwoman in...

A woman, Tome, is born to a lower class family in Japan in 1918. The title refers to an insect, repeating its mistakes, as in an infinite circle. Imamura, with this metaphor, introduces the life of Tome, who keeps trying to change her poor life.

fg: History of Postwar Japan as Told by a Bar Hostess
Karayuki-San, the Making of a Prostitute
Warm Water Under a Red Bridge
imamura.desc: Ozu's former assistant, who reacted against his refinement. He filmed pimps, bar hostesses and peasants with an anthropologist's curiosity and earthy humour.
imamura.sig: Said he was interested in the lower part of the human body and the lower part of the social structure.
facts: Founded a film school in Yokohama.
Turned to documentary for much of the 1970s.
lists: Won the Palme d'Or twice: The Ballad of Narayama (1983) and The Eel (1997, shared).
1 film received votes in the 2022 Sight and Sound critics' poll; the highest is The Ballad of Narayama at #608.
3 films in Cahiers du cinéma's top 10 of the year, 1989 to 1998.
Named on 5 pages of The Oxford History of World Cinema.

films.ov: An unemployed Brit vents his rage on unsuspecting strangers as he embarks on a nocturnal London odyssey.
After her adoptive mother dies, Hortense, a successful black optometrist, seeks out her birth mother. She's shocked when her research leads her to Cynthia, a working class white woman.
Eccentric British painter J.M.W. Turner  lives his last 25 years with gusto and secretly becomes involved with a seaside landlady, while his faithful housekeeper bears an unrequited love for him.
A look at a few chapters in the life of Poppy, a cheery, colorful, North London schoolteacher whose optimism tends to exasperate those around her.
During a year, a very content couple approaching retirement are visited by friends and family less happy with their lives.
Abortionist Vera Drake finds her beliefs and practices clash with the mores of 1950s Britain – a conflict that leads to tragedy for her family.

fg: The Birth of the Goalie of the 2001 F.A. Cup Final
Two Mikes Don't Make a Wright
leigh.desc: Develops each film from nothing through months of improvisation with the cast. The results are precisely scripted tragicomedies of English class and family.
leigh.sig: Builds his scripts through months of improvisation with the actors before shooting a word.
facts: His actors develop their characters separately and learn only what those characters would know.
Has a parallel career in theatre.
lists: Won the Palme d'Or for Secrets & Lies (1996).
2 films in the TSPDT 1,000 Greatest Films; the highest is Naked at #438.
2 films received votes in the 2022 Sight and Sound critics' poll; the highest is Naked at #414.
Named on 1 page of The Oxford History of World Cinema.

films.ov: Wealthy landlord Sarkar decides to direct all waste into the village to make space for his real estate project. However, the poor villagers agitate against his plan and the protest is led by Balraj.

chetananand.desc: A founder of the Hindi film company Navketan with his brother Dev Anand. Neecha Nagar is a social allegory that drew on Soviet montage and expressionist lighting.
chetananand.sig: Made the first Indian film honoured at Cannes.
facts: Neecha Nagar is based on Gorky's The Lower Depths.
Ravi Shankar composed its music.
His brothers Dev and Vijay Anand were also major figures in Hindi cinema.
lists: Won the top prize at Cannes for Neecha Nagar (1946, shared).

films.ov: Two drifters bum around, visit earthy women and discuss opening a car wash in Pittsburgh.

A stark portrayal of life among a group of heroin addicts who hang out in Needle Park in New York City. Played against this setting is a low-key love story between Bobby, a young addict and small-time hustler, and Helen, a homeless girl who finds in her relationship with Bobby the stability she...
A New York journalist lies when his fake story about a pimp describes a real pimp up for murder.

40 international directors were asked to make a short film using the original Cinematographe invented by the Lumière Brothers, working under conditions similar to those of 1895. There were three rules: (1) The film could be no longer than 52 seconds, (2) no synchronized sound was permitted, and (3)...
A 16-year-old aspiring photographer pursues a beautiful "older woman" of 22, a down-on-her-luck rock singer.

Lou Andreas Sand, a once famous model, recalls her past as she tries to make success in the modeling world of New York, her stressful workdays, her affair with Mark, an advertising executive, her friendship with photographer Aaron, and her downward spiral into ruin.

fg: The Day the Ponies Come Back
jerryschatzberg.desc: His early films observe drifters and addicts with a photographer's patience, on real streets and roads.
jerryschatzberg.sig: A fashion photographer who made three of the quietest films of New Hollywood.
facts: Shot the cover photograph of Bob Dylan's Blonde on Blonde.
The Panic in Needle Park gave Al Pacino his first leading role.
Scarecrow was photographed by Vilmos Zsigmond.
lists: Won the top prize at Cannes for Scarecrow (1973, shared).

films.ov: Heroin addict Mark Renton stumbles through bad ideas and sobriety attempts with his unreliable friends --Sick Boy, Begbie, Spud and Tommy. He also has an underage girlfriend, Diane, along for the ride. After cleaning up and moving from Edinburgh to London, Mark finds he can't escape the life he left behind as Begbie and Sick Boy come knocking.
A teenager reflects on his life after being accused of cheating on the Indian version of "Who Wants to be a Millionaire?".

Twenty-eight days after a killer virus was accidentally unleashed from a British research facility, a small group of London survivors are caught in a desperate struggle to protect themselves from the infected. Carried by animals and humans, the virus turns those it infects into homicidal maniacs --...
The true story of mountain climber Aron Ralston's remarkable adventure to save himself after a fallen boulder crashes on his arm and traps him in an isolated canyon in Utah.

Twenty-something Richard travels to Thailand and finds himself in possession of a strange map. Rumours state that it leads to a solitary beach paradise, a tropical bliss - excited and intrigued, he sets out to find it.

Fifty years into the future, the sun is dying, and Earth is threatened by arctic temperatures. A team of astronauts is sent to revive the Sun — but the mission fails. Seven years later, a new team is sent to finish the mission as mankind’s last hope.

fg: Not Even God Is Wise Enough
Oscar: Best Picture; Oscar: Best Director
London 2012 Olympic Opening Ceremony: Isles of Wonder
Free Your Mind: The Matrix Now
dannyboyle.desc: He came from theatre and television. His films are propelled by pop soundtracks, tilted angles and restless cutting.
dannyboyle.sig: Kinetic, music-driven filmmaking across every genre.
facts: Won the Best Director Oscar for Slumdog Millionaire.
Directed the opening ceremony of the 2012 London Olympics.
28 Days Later was shot largely on consumer digital video cameras.
lists: 1 film in the TSPDT 1,000 Greatest Films; the highest is Trainspotting at #692.
Won the Oscar for Best Director for Slumdog Millionaire (2008).
Won Best Picture with Slumdog Millionaire (2008).

films.ov: In the summer of 1983, a 17-year-old Elio spends his days in his family's villa in Italy. One day Oliver, a graduate student, arrives to assist Elio's father, a professor of Greco-Roman culture. Soon, Elio and Oliver discover a summer that will alter their lives forever.

Tennis player turned coach Tashi has taken her husband, Art, and transformed him into a world-famous Major champion. To jolt him out of his recent losing streak, she signs him up for a "Challenger" event — close to the lowest level of pro tournament — where he finds himself standing across the net...

A darkness swirls at the center of a world-renowned dance company, one that will engulf the artistic director, an ambitious young dancer, and a grieving psychotherapist. Some will succumb to the nightmare. Others will finally wake up.

Abandoned by her father, a young woman embarks on a thousand-mile odyssey through the backroads of America where she meets a disenfranchised drifter. But despite their best efforts, all roads lead back to their terrifying pasts and to a final stand that will determine whether their love can survive...

An American couple, Paul and Marianne, spend their vacation in Italy and experience trouble when Marianne invites a former lover and his teenage daughter to visit, which leads to jealousy and dangerous sexual scenarios.
An adolescent girl, living with her mother and her grandmother, will have her first sexual experiences in a heavy and excessive way.

fg: Arto Lindsay, Forgive the Beauty: The Love Factory
Pippo Delbono, You Have to Die: The Love Factory
lucaguadagnino.desc: He lingers on bodies, food, houses and landscapes, and is closely associated with the actress Tilda Swinton.
lucaguadagnino.sig: Sensual films of desire, appetite and summer light.
facts: I Am Love, A Bigger Splash and Call Me by Your Name are known as his Desire trilogy.
Remade Dario Argento's Suspiria.
lists: 1 film received votes in the 2022 Sight and Sound critics' poll; the highest is Call Me by Your Name at #702.

films.ov: Caught in the stranglehold of debt and structural adjustment, Africa is fighting for its survival. In the face of disaster, representatives of African society bring an action against international financial institutions. The trial takes place in Bamako, in the yard of a house, among its inhabitants.
Just outside of the Malian city of Timbuktu, now occupied by militant Islamic rebels who impose the Sharia on civilians and inconvenience their daily life, a cattleman kills a fisherman.

Aya, a young Ivorian woman in her early thirties, says no on her wedding day, to everyone’s astonishment. After emigrating to Asia, she works in a tea export shop with Cai, a 45-year-old Chinese man. Aya and Cai fall in love but can their affair survive the turmoil of their past and other people’s...

Before immigrating to the West, Abdallah travels to the coastal city of Nouadhibou, Mauritania, to visit his mother. Although he grew up there, Abdallah feels anything but at home in his old neighborhood: he can no longer speak the local dialect and he wears western clothes that immediately cast...

fg: Le Chameau et les bâtons flottants
abderrahmanesissako.desc: Born in Mauritania, raised in Mali and trained in Moscow. He builds films from loosely connected scenes of daily life.
abderrahmanesissako.sig: Gentle, mosaic-like films about Africa's place in a globalised world.
facts: Bamako puts the World Bank and IMF on trial in a family courtyard.
Timbuktu was nominated for the foreign-language Oscar.
lists: 2 films received votes in the 2022 Sight and Sound critics' poll; the highest is Bamako (Court, The) at #608.

films.ov: Sergio is a brooding, alienated man who works as a trash collector in Lisbon by day and roams the city streets by night seeking rough, anonymous sex with men. One night he meets a man who seems to be the embodiment of his tormented fantasies, and he becomes obsessed with the stranger until loneliness and unfulfilled desire propel him finally into a dark and dangerous animalistic state.
Stranded along a sublime river fjord in northern Portugal, an ornithologist is subjected to a series of brutal and erotic Stations-of-the-Cross-style tests.

After breaking up with her boyfriend, a woman named Odete descends into madness and claims to be pregnant with the child of her neighbour Pedro, who died in a car crash and is mourned by his boyfriend Rui.

On his deathbed, His Majesty Alfredo, King without a crown, is taken back to distant youth memories from the time when he dreamt of becoming a fireman. His encounter with instructor Afonso from the fire brigade, opens a new chapter in the life of the two young men devoted to love and desire, and...
A transgender woman attempts to rehabilitate her younger, drug-addicted boyfriend while also dealing with her ne’er-do-well son, a soldier who’s gone AWOL.
Made for the Venice Film Festival's 70th anniversary, seventy filmmakers made a short film between 60 and 90 seconds long on their interpretation of the future of cinema.

fg: The Last Time I Saw Macao
Where Do You Stand Now, João Pedro Rodrigues?
30/30 Vision: Three Decades of Strand Releasing
Where Is This Street? or With No Before or After
joaopedrorodrigues.sig: Portuguese queer cinema as fable and metamorphosis.
facts: Works closely with João Rui Guerra da Mata.
lists: 1 film received votes in the 2022 Sight and Sound critics' poll; the highest is Fantasma, O at #702.
1 film in Cahiers du cinéma's top 10 of the year, 2010 to 2010.

films.ov: After young Mary Gibson discovers that her older sister Jacqueline has disappeared, she leaves her boarding school and heads to New York City to track down her sibling. But Mary gets drawn deeper into the mystery.
Various interconnected people struggle to survive when an earthquake of unimaginable magnitude hits Los Angeles, California.

Von Ryan's Express stars Frank Sinatra as a POW colonel who leads a daring escape from WWII Italy by taking over a freight train, but he has to win over the British soldiers he finds himself commanding.

Jobless sportswriter Eddie Willis is hired by corrupt fight promoter Nick Benko to promote his current protégé, an unknown Argentinian boxer named Toro Moreno. Although Moreno is a hulking giant, his chances for success are hampered by a powder-puff punch and a glass jaw. Exploiting Willis'...

Lured by their dreams of fame and fortune, three ambitious young women enter the world of show business and discover how easy it is to sink into a celebrity nightmare of ego, alcohol and pills — the beloved "dolls."

On a Greek island during the 1912 war, several people are trapped by quarantine for the plague. If that isn't enough worry, one of the people—a superstitious old peasant—suspects a young woman of being a vampiric demon.

fg: The Inn of the Sixth Happiness
markrobson.desc: He later made large studio melodramas.
markrobson.sig: An editor who began as a director in Val Lewton's horror unit.
facts: Was an assistant editor on Citizen Kane.
lists: 1 film received votes in the 2022 Sight and Sound critics' poll; the highest is The Seventh Victim at #850.

films.ov: An unusual story of a triangular relationship in Vienna. A woman shares an apartment with a man named Malina. The woman meets Ivan and falls under his spell. It will be her last great passion. Her feelings are so strong and all-encompassing that Ivan can neither understand nor return them.
A series of tableaux illustrating the life and death of a celebrated 19th century German opera singer.
A mentally unstable woman and her son move to a sprawling mansion in Portugal to grow roses.

fg: Maria Callas singt 1957 Rezitativ und Arie der Elvira aus Ernani 1844 von Giuseppe Verdi
Auf der Suche nach der Sonne
wernerschroeter.desc: Devoted to opera and to Maria Callas, he made stylised, ecstatic films of grand emotion, admired by Fassbinder, from Eika Katappa to The Kingdom of Naples.
wernerschroeter.sig: The operatic extremist of New German Cinema.
facts: The Rose King was his last film with Magdalena Montezuma, made as she was dying.
lists: 1 film in Cahiers du cinéma's top 10 of the year, 1981 to 1981.

films.ov: Two young men, one rich, one middle class, both in love with the same woman, become US Air Corps fighter pilots and, eventually, heroic flying aces during World War I. Devoted best friends, their mutual love of the girl eventually threatens their bond. Meanwhile, a hometown girl who's the lovestruck lifelong next door neighbor of one of them pines away.
A posse discovers a trio of men they suspect of murder and cow theft and are split between handing them over to the law or lynching them on the spot.

Two young Chicago hoodlums, Tom Powers and Matt Doyle, rise up from their poverty-stricken slum life to become petty thieves, bootleggers and cold-blooded killers. But with street notoriety and newfound wealth, the duo feels the heat from the cops and rival gangsters both. Despite his ruthless criminal reputation, Tom tries to remain connected to his family, however, gang warfare and the need for revenge eventually pull him away.

Esther Blodgett is just another starry-eyed farm kid trying to break into the movies. Waitressing at a Hollywood party, she catches the eye of her idol Norman Maine, is sent for a screen test, and before long attains stardom as newly minted Vicki Lester. She and Norman marry, though his career soon...
In 1867, a gang robs a bank and flees into the desert. Out of water, the outlaws encounter a ghost town called Yellow Sky and its only residents, a hostile young woman and her grandfather.
When a small-town girl is incorrectly diagnosed with a rare, deadly disease, an unknowing newspaper columnist turns her into a national heroine.

williamawellman.desc: A First World War pilot who directed hard-edged studio films across genres, from Wings and The Public Enemy to The Ox-Bow Incident.
williamawellman.sig: Directed Wings, winner of the first Best Picture.
facts: Flew with the Lafayette Flying Corps in France during the First World War.
Directed the original A Star Is Born (1937).
lists: Won Best Picture with Wings (1927/28).
